title: AgedBooks
description: This Texturepack makes books look old.
body:
This Texturepack makes books look very old and ancient, by making them a bit yellowed.
It changes the looks of: Book and Quill, Enchanted Books, Signed Books, the normal book, the Book and Quill UI.

**Note:

If you download this File dont be mistaken if Minecraft says that the texturepack is made for an older / newer version of Minecraft it will work for almost every Version released (Though not always perfectly).**
Made with love by Venaticshelf408 :)
